§6Coal Gasoline§f

§aCoal-derived fuel with massive energy density - 6.35 MTU per bucket from coal and heavy oil!§f

Coal Gasoline is a hybrid fuel produced by processing §bHeavy Oil§f with coal products or by hydrotreating §bCoal Oil§f. At §e6.35 MTU§f and §e9.52 MHE§f per bucket, it is one of the most energy-dense liquid fuels available.

§6Production§f:
§b• Hydrotreater§f: §e1,000mB§f Coal Oil + §e100mB§f Liquid Hydrogen → §e800mB§f Coal Gasoline + §e150mB§f Sour Gas.
§b• Fractioning Tower§f: §e100mB§f Coal Oil → §e30mB§f Coal Gasoline + §e70mB§f Crude Oil.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f Leaded Coal Gasoline: §e10,000mB§f + Tetraethyllead → §e12,000mB§f (§e9.52 MTU§f / §e14.2 MHE§f).
§b•§f Generator fuel for massive power output.
§b•§f Chainsaw fuel.

§ePS:§f Coal Gasoline has roughly §e10×§f the energy density of regular Gasoline! The Hydrotreater route is most efficient. Adding Tetraethyllead gives a §e20%§f volume bonus - worth the cost.
